connectorUiConfig.title: XposedOrNot Breach Intelligence (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [XposedOrNot](https://xposedornot.com) data connector ingests breach exposure data for your verified domains into Microsoft Sentinel using the Codeless Connector Framework. It polls the XposedOrNot API on the schedule you choose and stores exposed email addresses in `XposedOrNotExposures_CL` and breach details in `XposedOrNotBreachCatalog_CL`. Any domain you verify in XposedOrNot is picked up automatically on the next poll.

sampleQueries.query:
XposedOrNotBreachExposures
| project FirstSeen, Email, Domain, BreachName, BreachedDate, PasswordRisk
| order by FirstSeen desc
| take 100

sampleQueries.description: Exposures with plaintext or easy to crack passwords
sampleQueries.query:
XposedOrNotBreachExposures
| where PasswordRisk in ('plaintext', 'easytocrack')
| summarize Breaches = make_set(BreachName) by Email, Domain

sampleQueries.description: Exposed email addresses per monitored domain
sampleQueries.query:
XposedOrNotBreachExposures
| summarize ExposedEmails = dcount(Email), Breaches = dcount(BreachName) by Domain
| order by ExposedEmails desc

dataTypes.name: XposedOrNotExposures_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
XposedOrNotExposures_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

dataTypes.name: XposedOrNotBreachCatalog_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
XposedOrNotBreachCatalog_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: XposedOrNot API key
customs.description: An XposedOrNot API key is required. Get one from [xposedornot.com](https://xposedornot.com) (Community) or [plus.xposedornot.com](https://plus.xposedornot.com) (Enterprise).

customs.name: Verified domain
customs.description: At least one domain must be verified in your XposedOrNot account. The API returns data only for verified domains.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Get your XposedOrNot API key
instructionSteps.description: Sign in to the [XposedOrNot dashboard](https://xposedornot.com/dashboard) (Community) or [XposedOrNot Plus](https://plus.xposedornot.com) (Enterprise), verify the domains you want to monitor, and copy your API key. For help, see [how to get an API key for domain breach data](https://xposedornot.com/faq#collapse102).

instructionSteps.title: 2. Connect XposedOrNot to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: Enter your API key, choose how often Microsoft Sentinel checks for new exposures, and select Connect. The first data can take up to 30 minutes to appear.

parameters.text: Each refresh stores a full snapshot of your exposures, so a shorter schedule ingests more data. The XposedOrNot API allows 50 domain breach requests per day and every schedule offered here stays within that limit. To change the API key or schedule later, disconnect and connect again.
